localReproduction: Built preview reproduces both mobile Finish timeout and challenge widget assertion failure with intercepted API/provider traffic.
causes: Later unified editor CSS overrides the equally specific mobile toolbar wrap declaration in the production bundle.
The closed account dialog mounts AccountAccess and its verification widget before any account action.
fix: Scope the mobile wrap rule with the actual pg-app and pg-unified classes so it wins independent of stylesheet order.
Mount account controls only while the account dialog is open, preserving the mounted project/editor.
